name: Yindu Kitchen Equipment Co., Ltd
summary: Yindu Kitchen Equipment Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and service of commercial catering equipment in China and internationally. The company offers commercial refrigeration equipment, which include commercial refrigerators, display cabinets, cake cabinets, ice makers, and other related products; western kitchen equipment, such as ovens, griddles, fryers, clay pot ovens, steam ovens, workbenches, and other related products; and buffet equipment, including buffet stoves, soup stoves, juice dispensers, dining carts, serving plates, and other related products.
